programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 吳哥金屬工藝是柬埔寨特別的藝術品，本集將會講述製作過程及其背後意義。印度教神話故事對柬埔寨藝術的影響十分深遠, 工匠把故事刻在工藝品上, 希望可以讓故事繼續流傳, 並延續祖先文化的傳統

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 如果這樣生活粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 九名藝員分別起程，前赴中國內地、日本、台灣體驗另類生活，分享自己的故事及旅程得着。余德丞先為觀眾聲音導航，揭開十集節目的序幕。黎諾懿自小嚮往尋找一個適合長居的世外桃園，跟另一半歸隱田園過簡單生活。諾懿深入雲南大理某個村落，探訪一位寧願放棄米芝蓮廚師職位的隱居法籍大廚。愛煮食的諾懿一到埗便參觀廚房，發覺簡單的生活都可以有要求！他隨後與大廚一同買菜以及走進農場捉雞，卻「投訴」毫無難度！

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: Camping最終回，一於玩大佢！雙豪帶來幾十公斤的營具起營，再邀請吳若希、戴祖儀、謝東閔、胡蓓蔚、姚子羚、楊潮凱到場，合力炮製竹燒雞、火焰三文魚、法國燒青口等美食，期間八人同玩數字球，重拾童真。雙豪、潮凱、東閔因《使徒行者2》而熟絡，原來東閔真人與角色名字一樣「撻Q」頻頻，但最後發現問題在柏豪身上？若希因前男友而喜歡柏豪？如可選擇，子羚希望兩位小生做她的哥哥和弟弟。祖儀卻認為Ben適合做保鑣？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 心理內耗是指人過度思考、自我懷疑，消耗心理能量卻沒有實際行動。兩位谷主坦承常陷於其中，凱文在工作上不時自我懷疑，以至一度陷入容貌焦慮，凱婷則會因年齡引發不安。谷主瀅仴帶來內耗型人格的自我評估，發現現場三人都屬於高度內耗。凱文更自言有討好型人格特質，小時候常因害怕被人討厭而反覆內耗。瀅仴提到，內耗或與心理學的「反芻思考」相關。談到如何能擺脫心理內耗，放下執着、轉移注意力等都是眾谷主認同的可行方法。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 福祿壽訓練學院粵
programme.desc: 學員入圍後首個挑戰是合作項目︰福祿壽訓練學院頒獎典禮，要聯同三名導師扮演歌、影、視不同藝人，送上別開生面的「仿頒獎禮」。「十大天王」演繹現實四大天王歌聲作開場，然後逐一頒發「年度電影演員」、「年度歌手」、「年度電影演員」三個獎項，分別由王信號、美少女戰士與鄭燶基奪得。九人男團Kowloon帶來<閃耀演出。壓軸頌發「福祿壽訓練學院榮譽博士」，王祖藍、阮兆祥、李思捷藉扮嘢表演形式，向得主盧海鵬致敬。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集Gigi姐教大家做一道大人和小孩都喜歡的菜式︰茄汁蝦。首先她會介紹選用的蝦，再教大家用較少油的方法來為蝦泡油，然後處理配料和做醬汁，最後把蝦回鍋再炒。重點是蝦泡油和回鍋的技巧，她都為大家一一講解。

programme.title: 2026《英雄聯盟：雲頂之弈》公開賽秋季賽-總決賽直播粵普
programme.desc: 2026《英雄聯盟：雲頂之弈》公開賽秋季賽火熱舉行，中國賽區的精英選手集結雲頂賽場，逐鹿爭鋒！八位踏上總決賽舞台的選手，同場開展回合制策略博弈，藉20分登頂奪冠賽制，角逐人民幣100萬元的冠軍獎金。主持戴祖儀、林沚羿、施焯日、小編黃瀅仴，邀得電競賽事評述員老星、香港職業電競選手張浩生作出聲音導航，嘉賓羅泳嫻也會帶來玄學看點。11月7日緊貼TVB翡翠台、明珠台，同迎冠軍弈手登頂時刻！

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 去年大埔宏福苑五級火，造成168人死亡。獨立委員會花10個月時間，檢視上百萬個檔案、舉行30場聽證會，審視意外成因、系統性問題等，揭示多個政府部門在監管上失職。特首李家超曾強調會「問責到底」，這宗本港史上最嚴重的住宅火警，應該如何追討責任？政府建議推出多項改革，包括將圍標行為刑事化及成立樓宇維修支援及服務局，能否堵塞漏洞，防止悲劇重演？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 事主光顧在網上搜尋的租車公司，取車時已見車身有劃痕並拍照為證，還車後幾天卻接通知因車痕被扣去逾六千按金。事主為此入稟「小額錢債」獲勝訴，但涉事公司不退款兼失聯。《璀璨之城》劇組聚首澳門觀賞大結局，眾演員細談感受。公屋戶成功申請調遷到較小的頂層單位，裝修期間卻有神秘黑水由天花滲出，難以清洗！專家上門檢測，結論怎樣？房署對事件又有何回應？近期謠傳可於報攤買到未完稅煙草，這集帶來海關嚴厲打擊私煙的資訊。

programme.title: 渣打優先理財呈獻：Grand住去首爾粵
programme.desc: 嘉洛、朱仔迎來期待已久的行程。韓流明星兼健身達人金鐘國現身，貼身指導二人重訓，嘉洛笑言故意做錯來製造身體接觸。鐘國展示「最強能力者」的健碩腹肌，還即場展現邊哼歌邊健身的驚人體能。運動過後，三人會合海寧，由鐘國親自烤肉，讓主持們品嚐地道韓燒。兩男轉戰頂級炭火燒肉店，享用惹味的奢華韓牛。再踏足高麗蔘水療中心，體驗按摩、頭部水療與面部護理；壓軸和海寧深入以韓國巫堂文化為靈感的酒吧，店內還可查看自身玄機。

programme.title: 香港旅遊發展局呈獻：香港連場好戲粵
programme.desc: 香港獨特城市面貌，吸引荷里活電影來港拍攝。「變形金剛」於鰂魚涌建築群留下打鬥痕跡，製片人細談街景獲選中的經過。「盜墓者」為銅鑼灣地標注入冒險氣息，任達華憶述戲裡戲外點滴。高樓大廈、法定古蹟帶來科幻感，「蝙蝠俠」從中環地標躍下、唐樓大宅變「奇異博士」至聖所，背後有何故事？地道街市、異國風情也獲外國導演青睞，隨「攻殼隊」、「特務」足跡探索光影。踏足星光大道、海上酒吧，細味維港璀璨夜景與電影殿堂印記。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 本港有不少傑出女車手，鄧曉琳隨父親步伐投身賽車，她如何在運動與學業上取得平衡？黃敬慈也受父親耳濡目染而成為車手，更藉賽車學校與社交媒體推廣這運動。山地單車港將伍立熙細談運動點滴，以及前輩陳振興帶來的影響。氣排球與一般排球有甚麼分別？學員暢談參加訓練班感受。另外，中國女排前隊長孫玥分享經驗。帆船、賽艇港隊於亞運獲佳績，眾將開心慶功。另搜羅北都馬拉松、港超足球、甲一籃球的戰報，以及三人籃球賽記招花絮。

programme.title: 飛虎3壯志英雄#19粵PG
programme.desc: 許森趁機向張嘉軒套話，得知警方正在調查杜文彬的事。保安局在壓力下答應將蔡肇培移交給國際反恐組織，但俊飛並沒有按照慣例把他帶回總部。文彬趕去和金智海見面，嘉軒和家寶一直跟蹤，文彬發現後拚命甩掉他們…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 事主光顧在網上搜尋的租車公司，取車時已見車身有劃痕並拍照為證，還車後幾天卻接通知因車痕被扣去逾六千按金。事主為此入稟「小額錢債」獲勝訴，但涉事公司不退款兼失聯。《璀璨之城》劇組聚首澳門觀賞大結局，眾演員細談感受。公屋戶成功申請調遷到較小的頂層單位，裝修期間卻有神秘黑水由天花滲出，難以清洗！專家上門檢測，結論怎樣？房署對事件又有何回應？近期謠傳可於報攤買到未完稅煙草，這集帶來海關嚴厲打擊私煙的資訊。

programme.title: 街市新鮮人粵
programme.desc: 新式街市顛覆舊有形象，林正峰、劉頌鵬往沙田區街市打卡，以牆上壁畫出帖騙讚！主持跟拍檔譚玉瑛到街市買雞，向家禽檔第三代負責人請教選雞之道，並了解其家業檔口多年來的轉變。話說回頭，他繼承父業是被迫，還是自願接棒？也有廣告設計從業員轉職經營蔬菜檔，將設計美學運用於陳列貨品，要點是「分門別類，有主有次」。街市內亦設食街，讓市民盡情掃街，眾人一試特色腸粉、黃白配甜品、炸雞髀等美食；另可買走手工餃子「加餸」！

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: Camping最終回，一於玩大佢！雙豪帶來幾十公斤的營具起營，再邀請吳若希、戴祖儀、謝東閔、胡蓓蔚、姚子羚、楊潮凱到場，合力炮製竹燒雞、火焰三文魚、法國燒青口等美食，期間八人同玩數字球，重拾童真。雙豪、潮凱、東閔因《使徒行者2》而熟絡，原來東閔真人與角色名字一樣「撻Q」頻頻，但最後發現問題在柏豪身上？若希因前男友而喜歡柏豪？如可選擇，子羚希望兩位小生做她的哥哥和弟弟。祖儀卻認為Ben適合做保鑣？

programme.title: 如果這樣生活粵
programme.desc: 九名藝員分別起程，前赴中國內地、日本、台灣體驗另類生活，分享自己的故事及旅程得着。余德丞先為觀眾聲音導航，揭開十集節目的序幕。黎諾懿自小嚮往尋找一個適合長居的世外桃園，跟另一半歸隱田園過簡單生活。諾懿深入雲南大理某個村落，探訪一位寧願放棄米芝蓮廚師職位的隱居法籍大廚。愛煮食的諾懿一到埗便參觀廚房，發覺簡單的生活都可以有要求！他隨後與大廚一同買菜以及走進農場捉雞，卻「投訴」毫無難度！

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 吳哥金屬工藝是柬埔寨特別的藝術品，本集將會講述製作過程及其背後意義。印度教神話故事對柬埔寨藝術的影響十分深遠, 工匠把故事刻在工藝品上, 希望可以讓故事繼續流傳, 並延續祖先文化的傳統

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、胡諾言、梁嘉琪、陳浚霆到訪石鼓洲康復院，男院友平日負責修葺設施，而由院友一手一腳建成的羅馬式儲水池，令眾主持嘆為觀止。六人難得來到，當然不只是遊覽。他們分成兩隊做義工，一組展開「髹牆」旅程，另一組則修剪草坪，埋頭苦幹了一個早上。辛苦事陸續有來，眾人最後還要修建道路，要知道擔泥舖地絕非小兒科粗活，他們雖然做到汗流浹背，但大功告成的一刻卻有種難以形容的滿足。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 吳家樂、滕麗名、胡諾言、江欣燕、梁嘉琪、陳浚霆繼續在石鼓洲康復院服務，先嘗試廢物利用「揼鞋架」，事後竟強迫木工導師稱讚每份傑作！眾人又自告奮勇清潔獨立「羊」房、露天龜池，一邊做一邊胡鬧，在勞碌的探訪中尋找樂趣。石鼓洲風光宜人，欣欣與阿滕趁美景當前，展露巧手廚藝鼓勵院友；禮尚往來，院方義工亦炮製了「石鼓洲炒飯」分甘同味。回到市區，家樂邀請張智軒、喬寶寶與立志遠離毒品的年青人比賽足球，戰況如何？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 多位「好戲之人」同來接受Do姐考驗，田蕊妮與李思捷組隊，迎戰黎耀祥和胡定欣。泰國夜市海鮮檔為食客提供「三寶」，當中的冰桶有甚麼作用？阿田答對題目，為何卻咀咒自己會扣分？台北貓舍收容了不少貓貓，負責人想出「屎橋」，能讓貓咪們「自給自足」！東京老字號專賣店主打一種竹製品，到底是甚麼？雨傘專門店有售超過一萬把雨傘，其中一款設計獨特的「縮骨遮」更可用作保護某物件。今集兌換獎金創出新高，哪一隊是幸運兒？

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 隨韻潔到台中一間由舊樓改建的旅宿，牆身的鋼筋、水泥突顯出原始、粗獷感，而天井配合燈光有何效果？露台除可增加採光度，當中的植物亦為舊建築帶來生命力。台11線兼具山海靚景，當地一間被藤蔓覆蓋的旅宿，原始簡樸；另一間以灰、黑為主調的旅宿，荒廢感在蔚藍海岸及翠綠植物旁尤為突出，不妨在此享受寧靜、悠閒。一間為單人打造的旅宿，為甚麼會以三角形打造空間？房間陳設都是向外擺放，讓客人享受獨處時光，同時享受大自然。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣近年越趨重視宗教建築設計，除了知名建築師姚仁喜設計的農禪寺，由德國得獎設計師打造的菁寮聖十字架天主堂亦富有特色。四個鋁建的金字塔形屋頂各有雕像，而教堂內有何融入台灣文化的設計？台灣護聖宮以玻璃圍繞，可謂突破傳統廟宇的形像，亦結合科技，令建築能抵抗強風與地震。位於宜蘭的長老教會，建築師特意將主堂撐起，亦讓天然光線透進內部建築，主堂的木質蛋形結構有何意思？建築師又講解教堂設計與聖經故事的連繫。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 吉祥物Bug Bug CHU身體不適，讓老氣妹壞壞相當擔心，更找上小光商量。就在這時，神秘人物在她們面前出現，並說只有做演唱會才能治好Bug Bug CHU，但老氣妹壞壞並不擅長唱歌跳舞，情急之下又向小光求助……

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 一群小孩聚集在空地，大家都找到趣味相投的人一起玩以及交流，但唯獨喜歡花繩的大雄孤獨一人。胖虎聽完叔叔的一番說話之後，決定不再欺負人，並且對弱者加以保護。大雄被選中為受保護的對象。

programme.title: 古典樂之星粵日
programme.desc: 貝多芬考試不及格，再此下去會有退學之虞。蕭邦願意為貝多芬補習，但交換條件是貝多芬成為蕭邦隨從，貝多芬惟有陪他採訪、購物，被他連番折騰。但接下來蕭邦在舞台上的表現，卻震撼了不忘重返拳擊的貝多芬。

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊粵
programme.desc: 衍峰、秀怡、嘉慧在重慶未玩夠，繼續遊走。先「貼地」搭民生鐵路，路軌卻離地甚高，絕對「不貼地」，鐵路還會「穿越」大廈，而要影到「吞鐵」打卡相原來不易！食方面亦繼續貼地，坐上矮櫈，將辣麵放在高櫈上進食，品嚐其「麻辣鮮香」的特色！再試由幾種家鄉風味隨意混搭出的草根美味，一嚐江湖菜滋味。突發盲盒任務，三人被蒙眼帶往某景點，打開眼罩已置身高空玻璃平台，節目組還安排升級任務，要主持們在懸空步道走一圈！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 經歷高低起跌，名廚黃永幟對烹飪仍保持一份堅持與執着。幟哥親力親為到海鮮市場揀貨，芷珊前往取經，再一嚐惹火龍蝦菜。XO醬如何由名貴小食變特色調味料？這位「XO醬兼楊枝甘露之父」談及味道平衡的重要。人生下半場決心轉行，匠人蘇炎文將裁縫精神注入流心燉蛋，更闖出名堂。除了揀蛋、奶有要求，燉煮時間都超精準！蝦子麵要將麵粉與高湯完美調和，麵廠主理人陳漢傑承繼父業後體會到父親之苦。老字號引入改革，面對甚麼挑戰？

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 本地掀起多時的新派酥皮蛋撻熱潮，與一位在港落地生根的瑞士烘焙大師息息相關。大師焗製的酸種蛋撻據悉每日吸引長龍，為免顧客撲空失望，他更不辭勞苦加班製作。他亦熱愛香港美食，還嘗試將叉燒等融入包餅中。清晨開爐熬製的香綿粥底，加上以銅煲滾煮，一碗美味的鮮魚粥才告誕生。據指有外地人念念不忘專程再來吃粥，支持主理人的烹調用心。潮州菜館師傅醉心鑽研滷水，勇敢跳出傳統框架，採用嶄新材料搭配，芷珊大讚出品層次豐富。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 來到陽光海岸，動靜皆宜，漫步六十公里長灘好Chill；乘坐前水警艇在海上高速起伏、轉彎，則刺激十足！到農場擠駱駝奶先要取得其信任？駱駝也「黏人」，還主動向芷珮「送抱」。再結識另一動物朋友，騎馬踏步海灘，迎接閃閃浪花。遊船河感受原住民風情，兼享美酒佳餚，深入了解當地文化。行逛人氣市集後，芷珮勇闖叢林挑戰高空飛索、繩網障礙，考驗身手與膽量。大沼澤地生態也值得遊人探索，坐船穿梭河道濕地，見識大自然奧妙。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 港姐季軍郭嘉文勤奮好學，自當選以來工作機會不斷。她在節目中接受另一挑戰，與阿古(古嘉俊)合力製作一款「茉莉熱情果薑味牛奶朱古力馬卡龍」，融合二人創意炮製出精彩滋味。期間阿古竟要她將牛油紙視為「仇人」？

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 希娜要為雜誌拍照，祭跟著去學習，同場的還有米露琪。另一名模特兒因病缺席，攝影師相中祭，讓她臨時頂替，米露琪不是味兒，故意教祭錯誤知識。最後工作人員提議拍攝星光魔法，米露琪竟然推卻。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 十一歲男生受表哥薰陶而對法國號產生興趣。他將這款音色獨特的管樂器帶上「My Little Show」舞台，即場吹奏一曲。十位小朋友同聲合唱< Somewhere over the rainbow，主持姐姐大讚聲音柔和，令人容易投入歌曲中的故事。圍繞「校園成長」主題，主持們與結他導師合唱<分飛燕、<十八相送。大家還分享讀書時的青春熱血回憶，Emily和Tiffany姐姐均自言是安靜的乖寶寶。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子被推舉成為組長，負責統籌話劇排練，起初因受稱讚而得意，後因貪玩取消練習惹眾人不滿，終承認錯誤。小丸子陪爺爺搭巴士去做針灸，覺得按下車鈴充滿樂趣，後來卻發現有一男孩搶著按鈴。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 社會對疾病預防及健康管理的觀念越來越重視，除了醫院及醫療集團，紛紛投放資源開展相關服務。近年連一些非醫療機構都轉型開拓復康、護理等新業務，這個現象會為本地醫療產業發展帶來怎樣的變化？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
邵逸夫獎2026粵
programme.desc: 2026年度邵逸夫天文學獎平均頒予野本憲一，以及斯坦福‧伍斯利，以表彰他們對恆星爆炸和元素起源的研究。而數學科學獎則由伊曼紐爾‧康德斯和卡米洛‧德‧雷列斯獲得，以表彰他們在運用深刻數學分析技術，解決重要應用方面取得的突破性貢獻。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷粵
programme.desc: 本集延續台北試食行程。主持們於午市光顧高評分素食餐廳，看到座無虛席的場面，原本寄予厚望。無奈嚐過絲瓜小籠包、酸菜魚等菜式後，某主持直言該店名大於實！珍珠奶茶配鍋燒意麵的破格組合，令朱仔入店前亦想「縮沙」。儘管湯頭的奶茶味道「失蹤」，大家卻都讚意麵相當滋味。喝湯可反映身體健康狀況，而每位要索價逾六百港元？湯還未入口，美儀姐單憑氣味已臉色一變；朱仔自言愛喝湯，美儀姐即提醒他不要盲目「立Flag」……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵
programme.desc: 女神水上常識問答比賽，眾男考驗對同組女神的了解度，還要激鬥浮台搶位戰！遊戲揭露女神小秘密，識得開槍、鍾意聞男友汗味都未算誇，某女神竟試過被十多位男士同時追求？不分組別專屬題戰火升級，情敵們為博表現正面交鋒，有人參戰只求搞事？本輪最高分的女神可揀對象共度浪漫約會，人選估你唔到！好感度投票時間，花生團會淘汰兩名求愛勇者，女神如零票也難逃出局命運。殘酷過後有福利，收穫吊墜的男士將可與女神單獨過夜……

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻：一周星星粵
programme.desc: 主持王鎮泉邀來「模範夫妻」吳岱融和鍾淑慧要取經，但泉叔跟岱融哥竟於《巨輪II》有合作？還是關注兩夫妻的緣分之始較恰當，一同重溫定情作《人．鬼．狐》。岱融哥當年被稱為「新加坡第一帥哥」，吸引淑慧的卻是其柔軟度似蜘蛛？岱融哥對老婆的初印象又是如何？岱融哥不時為妻子製造驚喜，令淑慧最深刻一次，發生甚麼事？岱融哥提到愛錫一個人，需常常將愛意告知對方；泉叔要求他在鏡頭前向淑慧講「我愛你」，岱融哥亦隨即行動！

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 黃妍對可跟原唱人劉浩龍「一晚限定」合唱<滄海遺珠大感高興，她同時亦帶來新歌<福來的日子。林奕匡受九十年代電影啟發靈感，創作出<初戀無限Touch。Michael C則藉<傷口不算甚麼，與不太好的緣分講再見；他還形容填詞人梁嘉茵是「聖母」，何出此言？此外，許文軒倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲，並相約MYNT魔音女團暢談參與節目後成團的各項挑戰。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 蕭欣浩博士帶行仔造訪元朗懷舊糖水舖，細味遠年陳皮紅豆沙、石磨芝麻糊湯圓等手工古法糖水，並細說相關典故。荔枝角的西班牙餐廳主打當地特色美食，以本地小銀魚、鮮魷炮製的脆炸小食及招牌海鮮飯，均不容錯過。大廚陳國強帶暉哥到台灣過江龍餐廳，享用「人氣」鐵觀音珍珠奶茶及半筋半肉紅燒牛肉麵，風味正宗。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到荃灣的酒店，品嚐特色下午茶，包括鴨肝西多士及由區內老字號食店供應的馳名糯米糍，滋味十足。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
飛虎3壯志英雄#20粵PG
programme.desc: 高子樂發現杜以盈乘坐的車上有血跡，覺得可疑，卻在許森的舉報下，拿不到行車記錄儀的紀錄；嘉軒回憶起與許森一起長大的故事，許的神祕面紗慢慢揭開；Mike發現有人跟蹤他，跟蹤者還很快被滅口，一切矛頭指向Mike。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 來到陽光海岸，動靜皆宜，漫步六十公里長灘好Chill；乘坐前水警艇在海上高速起伏、轉彎，則刺激十足！到農場擠駱駝奶先要取得其信任？駱駝也「黏人」，還主動向芷珮「送抱」。再結識另一動物朋友，騎馬踏步海灘，迎接閃閃浪花。遊船河感受原住民風情，兼享美酒佳餚，深入了解當地文化。行逛人氣市集後，芷珮勇闖叢林挑戰高空飛索、繩網障礙，考驗身手與膽量。大沼澤地生態也值得遊人探索，坐船穿梭河道濕地，見識大自然奧妙。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 港姐季軍郭嘉文勤奮好學，自當選以來工作機會不斷。她在節目中接受另一挑戰，與阿古(古嘉俊)合力製作一款「茉莉熱情果薑味牛奶朱古力馬卡龍」，融合二人創意炮製出精彩滋味。期間阿古竟要她將牛油紙視為「仇人」？

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊粵
programme.desc: 衍峰、秀怡、嘉慧在重慶未玩夠，繼續遊走。先「貼地」搭民生鐵路，路軌卻離地甚高，絕對「不貼地」，鐵路還會「穿越」大廈，而要影到「吞鐵」打卡相原來不易！食方面亦繼續貼地，坐上矮櫈，將辣麵放在高櫈上進食，品嚐其「麻辣鮮香」的特色！再試由幾種家鄉風味隨意混搭出的草根美味，一嚐江湖菜滋味。突發盲盒任務，三人被蒙眼帶往某景點，打開眼罩已置身高空玻璃平台，節目組還安排升級任務，要主持們在懸空步道走一圈！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 經歷高低起跌，名廚黃永幟對烹飪仍保持一份堅持與執着。幟哥親力親為到海鮮市場揀貨，芷珊前往取經，再一嚐惹火龍蝦菜。XO醬如何由名貴小食變特色調味料？這位「XO醬兼楊枝甘露之父」談及味道平衡的重要。人生下半場決心轉行，匠人蘇炎文將裁縫精神注入流心燉蛋，更闖出名堂。除了揀蛋、奶有要求，燉煮時間都超精準！蝦子麵要將麵粉與高湯完美調和，麵廠主理人陳漢傑承繼父業後體會到父親之苦。老字號引入改革，面對甚麼挑戰？

programme.title: 香港美食匠人粵
programme.desc: 本地掀起多時的新派酥皮蛋撻熱潮，與一位在港落地生根的瑞士烘焙大師息息相關。大師焗製的酸種蛋撻據悉每日吸引長龍，為免顧客撲空失望，他更不辭勞苦加班製作。他亦熱愛香港美食，還嘗試將叉燒等融入包餅中。清晨開爐熬製的香綿粥底，加上以銅煲滾煮，一碗美味的鮮魚粥才告誕生。據指有外地人念念不忘專程再來吃粥，支持主理人的烹調用心。潮州菜館師傅醉心鑽研滷水，勇敢跳出傳統框架，採用嶄新材料搭配，芷珊大讚出品層次豐富。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 隨韻潔到台中一間由舊樓改建的旅宿，牆身的鋼筋、水泥突顯出原始、粗獷感，而天井配合燈光有何效果？露台除可增加採光度，當中的植物亦為舊建築帶來生命力。台11線兼具山海靚景，當地一間被藤蔓覆蓋的旅宿，原始簡樸；另一間以灰、黑為主調的旅宿，荒廢感在蔚藍海岸及翠綠植物旁尤為突出，不妨在此享受寧靜、悠閒。一間為單人打造的旅宿，為甚麼會以三角形打造空間？房間陳設都是向外擺放，讓客人享受獨處時光，同時享受大自然。

programme.title: 十築台灣粵普
programme.desc: 台灣近年越趨重視宗教建築設計，除了知名建築師姚仁喜設計的農禪寺，由德國得獎設計師打造的菁寮聖十字架天主堂亦富有特色。四個鋁建的金字塔形屋頂各有雕像，而教堂內有何融入台灣文化的設計？台灣護聖宮以玻璃圍繞，可謂突破傳統廟宇的形像，亦結合科技，令建築能抵抗強風與地震。位於宜蘭的長老教會，建築師特意將主堂撐起，亦讓天然光線透進內部建築，主堂的木質蛋形結構有何意思？建築師又講解教堂設計與聖經故事的連繫。

programme.desc: 亨為宣傳特意斥資拍攝一系列瑜珈光碟，更擔任示範導師。可是，亨卻對瑜珈動作一知半解，悅忍不住開聲指點，令亨大怒，指責悅令他顏面盡失。二人回到高家又再吵了起來，令二人的另一半的麗和朋分別成磨心，苦不堪言。

programme.title: 玉樓春#36粵普
programme.desc: 李家人逼孫有德為丈夫殉情，林少春心生一計，暫時幫二姐姐度過難關；孫有德花錢為李想捐生員，他在縣學中聽到旁人對李櫻的議論，羞愧難當；李想背不出書，被考官抓起來，少春趁機慫恿李家分家來救李想。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 陸浩明想轉工任高薪陪月員，就要先學做坐月菜式。肥媽分享個人經驗，為何坐月不能吃牛肉、蝦、蟹或飲汽水？花膠該如何浸發？肥媽示範湯水「鷓鴣燉花膠」及甜品「低糖花膠燉鮮奶」做法，並提醒產婦不應吃太鹹或太甜，否則後果嚴重！滋補菜不一定充滿難度，「黑麻油雞」、「黨參紅棗杞子蒸桂魚」、「花生黑豆木耳肉片煮蛋」全部步驟簡單，隨時連不常下廚的男士，亦能以簡單滋補菜討好另一半！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 馬尾神經是脊髓神經的延續，如受壓會引致腳軟，甚或影響大小便能力，骨科醫生細說馬尾神經的三個主要功能。延誤治療後果嚴重，醫生提到可透過椎間盤切除手術治理，但長遠要注意日常護脊，為腰椎減壓。青年演員梁振文與梁芷萁因粵劇結下姻緣，最近還自組劇團，芷萁更為了粵劇而放棄專業律師工作？二人預告創團演出會演繹三套經典劇目，並鼓勵年輕朋友多欣賞粵劇，將藝術瑰寶傳承下去。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「金黃軟心牛肉卷」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵
programme.desc: 住宅門外的攝錄鏡頭，拍攝到鄰居出入情況，裝Cam目的或成違法與否的關鍵。祖儀拋書包引伸討論不誠實「使用」電腦罪與私隱條例，卻被律師連番糾正錯處！情侶打得火熱在居所露台做猥褻行為，被途人拍片，嘉賓譚俊彥反認為拍攝者犯法，結果如何？家中聯誼或會舉行現金賭局，女神們一致答中娛樂性質、不涉「抽水」，均沒有犯法，展現法律智慧。十五歲子女獨留在家卻誤生意外，家長可有法律責任？某女神再次答錯，被森美笑指陀衰家！

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#28粵PG
programme.desc: 金礦離開尤田，尤田以小報告及毛狄教唆他做壞事的罪證要脅他們協助偽造遺囑，假遺囑到手後，尤田問二人如何令尤長盡快去世時，尤長突然出現。尤田淪落至睡天橋底，坐在路邊時有人當他乞丐把錢幣扔給他。在野與靜雯為聯群傑黨及同鄉會宣傳時鬧得水火不容，靜雯更當街掌摑在野。遞交立法會議員選舉表格時，拉美宣布在野與靜雯即時分居。尤長病情惡化送院，靜雯欲捐肝但發現懷了身孕；秋水要求尤田捐肝，尤田要求尤長全副身家。

programme.desc: 丸尾打算仿傚美國向宇宙傳送訊息，小丸子和小玉亦被拖下水，三人開始構思訊息的內容。小丸子、姐姐和野口路過公園時發現一名女高中生發出魔性笑聲，野口於是想到把她的笑聲錄下來製成笑袋。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 跟正印花旦謝曉瑩學過小旦的步法後，便可參與「粵劇READY GO」的問答環節，記得要做足所有動作才能搶得作答權。在粵劇世界中，花木蘭擁有獨特的頭飾？水袖功、扇子功、飛刀功三個選項之中，哪個不屬於粵劇基本功？另外，這回繪畫課由玲玲姐姐提供指引，簡單幾筆就可畫出大象的頭部、耳朵和長鼻子。轉動輪盤選中紙飲管作上色工具，玲玲姐姐與Emily姐姐用到不同上色技巧，更向飲管吹氣「製造」出象鼻噴水的情景！

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄想成為孩子王，多啦A夢用「夢風鈴」讓他指揮熟睡的朋友，但即使如此，結果相撲仍然慘敗。大雄透過「時光電視」誤以為靜香會嫁給出木杉，為改變未來，他穿上「家務圍裙」，決心成為家務高手。

programme.desc: 元朗二手成交由高位回落三成，擴闊議價空間，區內較早發展的屋苑，樓價處於甚麼水平？

programme.title: 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 東張西望粵
黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#65粵
programme.desc: 圓圓暫代萬里擔任客戶總監，公司新來的見習生，竟是家境富裕的龔喜！圓圓大感疑惑，龔喜藉詞解釋，要求隱瞞二人相識。圓圓親自指導龔喜工作，帶她外出見客，期間龔喜刻意製造麻煩，原來另有盤算……圓圓向朱基打探龔喜入職目的，朱基支支吾吾有口難言，卻意外露了口風，圓圓發現端倪，懷疑龔喜身分殊不簡單，疑與冠一關係密切。文謙等人不知就裡，視龔喜如低級職員諸多差遣；圓圓制止眾人，並揭露其身分，真相卻令她大感意外……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#1粵PG 及 才駿HASHTAG 科技新指標粵
programme.desc: 夏無雙和關子盈識於微時，並一同加入娛樂圈，子盈更勇奪影后，後來卻傳來子盈投海消息……七年過去，無雙從子盈的日記中，驚悉其悲慘經歷。無雙以法國片廠亞太區代表身分，與天誠娛樂公司老闆陳雲生洽談重拍經典電影《玫瑰》。無雙又與子盈當年好友黎綺雲、藍鳳儀、梁菲雅、林安安重遇，還答應擔任四人所主持綜藝節目的嘉賓，她卻心知當年子盈遭逼上絕路，正與四人有關。節目錄影期間，似是有人存心要令四人自揭瘡疤、作賊心虛……

programme.title: 與廚同行 家樂牌專業餐飲呈獻：美食強人粵
programme.desc: 漢堡包主題戰場回歸香港，兩間本地代表皆在牛肉漢堡扒下功夫！藏身於太安樓內的參賽食店，挑選火鍋常用的新鮮騸牯牛炮製肉扒，並大膽融入蒸魚豉油與芫荽來調配中式漢堡醬，驚艷創意深受名廚李文星認可。有廚師評審提到這漢堡CP值超低，卻似乎走對了要追求突破、創新的香港餐飲業出路。中環則有由國際級名廚打造的漢堡，成品用上澳洲乾式熟成和牛主打製作，評審團對其肉質香氣評價兩極。作為配角的炸薯條，卻意外贏盡評審們歡心。

programme.title: 武則天#21粵普
programme.desc: 無忌承認派人刺殺媚娘；媚娘聯合東宮找出替代「武氏」以破解預言。徐慧受李泰挑撥，因妒砸碎手鐲，姊妹情盡。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
騙中傳奇#6粵PG
programme.desc: 殘生雖得到方孔賠償，但未能忘記當年方孔想獨吞碧綠觀音手，不惜斬斷他雙手，更將他置之死地，遂打暈顧井嫁禍給方孔；忠正欲對幫兇玉麟報復，卻發現玉麟竟是女兒身，在公堂拆穿她，更指控方孔賄賂殘生，令玉麟等人無地自容。皇上要將玉麟及方孔等人抄家，方孔受不住刺激，撤手塵寰，寶兒因此對玉麟恨之入骨。另外，玉麟及寶兒等人亦被囚入天牢。余實無心之言，令忠正對玉麟傷害顧井一事有所動搖，後見殘生行為古怪，不禁心下狐疑。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 馬尾神經是脊髓神經的延續，如受壓會引致腳軟，甚或影響大小便能力，骨科醫生細說馬尾神經的三個主要功能。延誤治療後果嚴重，醫生提到可透過椎間盤切除手術治理，但長遠要注意日常護脊，為腰椎減壓。青年演員梁振文與梁芷萁因粵劇結下姻緣，最近還自組劇團，芷萁更為了粵劇而放棄專業律師工作？二人預告創團演出會演繹三套經典劇目，並鼓勵年輕朋友多欣賞粵劇，將藝術瑰寶傳承下去。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「金黃軟心牛肉卷」。

programme.title: LAW霸女神粵
programme.desc: 住宅門外的攝錄鏡頭，拍攝到鄰居出入情況，裝Cam目的或成違法與否的關鍵。祖儀拋書包引伸討論不誠實「使用」電腦罪與私隱條例，卻被律師連番糾正錯處！情侶打得火熱在居所露台做猥褻行為，被途人拍片，嘉賓譚俊彥反認為拍攝者犯法，結果如何？家中聯誼或會舉行現金賭局，女神們一致答中娛樂性質、不涉「抽水」，均沒有犯法，展現法律智慧。十五歲子女獨留在家卻誤生意外，家長可有法律責任？某女神再次答錯，被森美笑指陀衰家！

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#28粵PG
programme.desc: 金礦離開尤田，尤田以小報告及毛狄教唆他做壞事的罪證要脅他們協助偽造遺囑，假遺囑到手後，尤田問二人如何令尤長盡快去世時，尤長突然出現。尤田淪落至睡天橋底，坐在路邊時有人當他乞丐把錢幣扔給他。在野與靜雯為聯群傑黨及同鄉會宣傳時鬧得水火不容，靜雯更當街掌摑在野。遞交立法會議員選舉表格時，拉美宣布在野與靜雯即時分居。尤長病情惡化送院，靜雯欲捐肝但發現懷了身孕；秋水要求尤田捐肝，尤田要求尤長全副身家。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#222粵
programme.desc: 亨為宣傳特意斥資拍攝一系列瑜珈光碟，更擔任示範導師。可是，亨卻對瑜珈動作一知半解，悅忍不住開聲指點，令亨大怒，指責悅令他顏面盡失。二人回到高家又再吵了起來，令二人的另一半的麗和朋分別成磨心，苦不堪言。

programme.title: 玉樓春#36粵普
programme.desc: 李家人逼孫有德為丈夫殉情，林少春心生一計，暫時幫二姐姐度過難關；孫有德花錢為李想捐生員，他在縣學中聽到旁人對李櫻的議論，羞愧難當；李想背不出書，被考官抓起來，少春趁機慫恿李家分家來救李想。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 燦爛的風和海
programme.desc: 【賽車手失意澳門 邂逅冷豔策展人共度浪漫情緣】在燈火輝煌的攝影棚與璀璨奪目的澳門之間，廣告導演麥又歌為夢想與責任奔波，結識熱心單純的機車青年徐君樂，在彼此的陪伴下逐漸打開封閉的心門。同時，賽車手韓俊豪在失利陰影與媒體質疑中掙扎，卻因邂逅神秘策展人陳嘉慧，而重新燃起追尋自我的勇氣。四人在工作、夢想與愛情的交織裡相遇，既面對現實的壓力，也學會傾聽心底的渴望。在陌生卻絢爛的城市裡，他們將一同經歷命運的考驗，找尋屬於自己的方向。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀念的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支持。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 女神降臨(完)
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 【安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！】以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中。當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力、揭露真相。在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間(完)
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 模範刑警
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 模範刑警(完)
programme.desc: 【孫賢周攜手張勝祖，最強刑警搭檔追查冤案揭開真相！！】資深刑警姜道昌憑經驗與直覺，與只相信證據的天才刑警吳志赫成了新搭檔。兩人辦案風格迥異，從衝突到合作，逐漸建立默契。面對五年前女高中生遇害的案件出現新的疑點，兩人聯手出擊揭開掩蓋的真相，對抗試圖隱瞞冤案的權力與勢力找出真兇。

Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.desc: Healthy eating sisters Jasmine and Melissa Hemsley cook up a feast of good-for-you recipes for when friends come round for dinner. Battling snowy paths with housekeeping, facing huge waves on fishing boats and chasing the Northern Lights is all in a day's work in the Arctic Circle.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Scarf
programme.desc: It's chilly, so Bella and Lift have fun with a snuggly scarf. In Boxtropolis, Sketch and the Playtimers make a no-snow snowman out of scrunchie socks and scarves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: It's one of those days. The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit ... hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Hurricane Rescue
programme.desc: Grim HQ struggles through the sky above the Atlantic Ocean, fighting against the powerful winds of a hurricane. One Grimbot falls overboard before the ship crash-lands at Go Jet Academy. Needing another ship to rescue the missing Grimbot, Grandmaster Glitch steals Jetpad. The Go Jetters give chase in the Grimbler, heading right into the eye of the storm.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Biogas Power
programme.desc: Glitch is excited when Lars refits the Grimbler with new, clean biogas boosters that could make it even faster than the Vroomster! The boosters run on gas made from food waste, and luckily there is plenty of leftover food in the academy canteen for the Grimbots to gather up. But Glitch overloads the boosters and BOOM! He loses control of the Grimbler and is sent flying across the academy, out of control. Lars leads the Go Jetters into action by giving chase across land and sea in the their all-a

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S23 - Out of Site
programme.desc: Brenda learns that it is important to work as a team and not just care about her own jobs.

programme.title: Nikhil &amp; Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Turmeric Superpower﻿
programme.desc: Jay gets turmeric on his hands and turns everything yellow! What if the whole world turns yellow because of his turmeric superpower?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Seaside
programme.desc: Myrtle, Sophie and Benjamin call Stanley to teach them how to make a sandcastle. Myrtle asks for a bigger one, so big it turns into a sandcastle resort!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Flower
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help her find a new place for her friend Isabelle the Sun-bell Daisy. This proves trickier than initially planned as Isabelle has some specific needs.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm An Actual Ninja You Know
programme.desc: From astronauts to acrobats, the animals talk about all the things they want to be when they grow up.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran S01 - It's time to harvest vegetables
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are making Great Gran Gran's St Lucian Callaloo soup, but can't buy the last few vegetables needed. Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan to harvest her own vegetables from the allotment.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Space Badge
programme.desc: Duggee teaches the squirrels all about the stars, the planets and the Milky Way!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Spooky Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound. They can see that something has spooked the chickens, so they stop what they are doing to investigate. They come across several different items, such as ghostly white footprints, and then they spot a floating sheet. What is going on? The Squirrels will have to take the long way round if they want to catch whatever it is.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Flying Party
programme.desc: Maisy flies her plane, and her friends join for a party in the sky.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Mermaid
programme.desc: Sing along with Maisy Mermaid!

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Watermelon
programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Artichoke
programme.desc: Little artichoke sings about being the rhyming queen.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Dino Danger
programme.desc: A toy dinosaur escapes from its box and scares the Grape Kids.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - The Chilli Rocket
programme.desc: Chilli pretends he's a superskateboarder, but he can't really skate at all!

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Mixed Up
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dispy, Laa­Laa and Po have their favourite things. The bag, the hat, the scooter and the ball all magically swap places and become mixed up.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S03 - Tiger
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'tiger' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a big tiger, a baby tiger, a stripy tiger and a growling tiger. We meet a swimming tiger, a climbing tiger, a cheeky tiger and even a tiger at a tea party! The journey is repeated with some surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Messy Gets Clean
programme.desc: It's wash day in Okido. Messy travels with Zoe and Felix to the Okido launderette and learns just how much soap can be too much. Soon Okido is covered in bubbles and it's up to Messy to clean up.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Happy Happy Valentines
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to deliver a superfun singing valentine. But the problem is, they don't know who it's for, or who it's from. Preston is racing to beat them to it!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mariana Trench: The Pacific Ocean
programme.desc: With the help of his hero Ron Allum, Lars plans to dive to the bottom of the Mariana Trench in a submersible called the Deep Sea Challenger. Glitch plans to beat him there by sending a Grimbot in his Grimsub, but it can't withstand the heavy pressure of the water. Lars and Xuli must work together to mount a rescue operation at the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Grandad
programme.desc: Grandad is supposed to be resting, but when Bluey and Bingo go to visit him, he makes a run for it with the kids and takes them on a madcap adventure into the bush.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: It's one of those days. The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit ... hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to the Valley of Balls in Kazakhstan, where they find thousands of rocks which are almost perfectly round. Meanwhile, Grandmaster Glitch is seeking the ideal ball to use to practise his bowling - something big and heavy. What could be better then one of the giant balls of rock from the Valley of Balls? But things start to go wrong for the Grandmaster when he rolls the ball of rock right out of Grim HQ and straight towards an unsuspecting group of tourists. The Go Jetters ta

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Hurricane Rescue
programme.desc: Grim HQ struggles through the sky above the Atlantic Ocean, fighting against the powerful winds of a hurricane. One Grimbot falls overboard before the ship crash-lands at Go Jet Academy. Needing another ship to rescue the missing Grimbot, Grandmaster Glitch steals Jetpad. The Go Jetters give chase in the Grimbler, heading right into the eye of the storm.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Emily's Best Friend
programme.desc: Emily worries that she doesn't have a best friend. Soon she realises she's been surrounded by best friends all along.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Cuppa King﻿
programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay help Appa get ready for his appearance on Mr Awan's channel, so that he can tell the world about his amazing Appa Cuppa! Can they help Appa overcome his camera shyness?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Recycling
programme.desc: Fred, Fifi and Ari call Stanley to help them with their recycling drive by coming up with a way of repurposing all the towns' old stuff. Stanley makes a crazy golf course!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Seaside
programme.desc: Myrtle, Sophie and Benjamin call Stanley to teach them how to make a sandcastle. Myrtle asks for a bigger one, so big it turns into a sandcastle resort!

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Ate My House
programme.desc: The talking animals chat about all the fun stuff about where they live.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to visit the dentist
programme.desc: JoJo has a check-up at the dentist and is hoping to earn a special sticker for looking after her teeth and keeping them clean and fresh!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Space Badge
programme.desc: Duggee teaches the squirrels all about the stars, the planets and the Milky Way!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Ambulance
programme.desc: Maisy and Charley help Eddie in their ambulance.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Flying Party
programme.desc: Maisy flies her plane, and her friends join for a party in the sky.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Watermelon
programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - The Chilli Rocket
programme.desc: Chilli pretends he's a superskateboarder, but he can't really skate at all!

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Carrot the Champion
programme.desc: Evil Pea captures Supertato, but Carrot masters the ultimate flip kick and rescues her.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Dizzy
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa‐Laa and Po drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. The Teletubbies have fun getting dizzy on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death-a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A triad boss seeks to clean up his image and win the mayoral seat amid a regime change. To raise funds and eliminate rivals, he sends Zheng Zha and Su Wan into action. When Zheng Zha’s undercover identity is exposed, he is killed by a corrupt superior, entrusting his mission to the mysterious Su Wan, who takes up the cause and seeks revenge.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.desc: 拍攝團隊花費多年跑遍全臺各大小廟宇，發現臺灣廟宇可見面向相當廣泛，不僅是民眾的信仰中心，還兼具民俗技藝、休閒、藝術…等功能，透過影片可以看見信徒對神明的感恩之心、祭典慶典時熱鬧的陣頭凝聚了當地的力量。

programme.title: 生活快易通第228集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第1集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 我的學校有夠酷第11集
programme.desc: 最有趣的學校課程單元探索台灣最酷特色小學， 認識不一樣的學校課程。發掘全台各小學充滿魅力且迷人的特色教學孩子化身為小老師、小職人、小導覽員，分享感受、展現自信與活力主持人沉浸式體驗校園酷趣事及不同面向學習環境，了解在地特色民情透過鏡頭，一起跟著孩子們探索台灣的多元文化吧！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1872集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 神奇故事屋第23集
programme.desc: 《神奇故事屋》描述在阿達叔叔的書房裏頭有一個奇幻通道，凡是在這個書房裡讀過的繪本，皆可以透過這個隧道進入到繪本的世界裏頭。故事屋就像時空任意門，帶他們到一個個不同的繪本中旅行。於是，孩子們跟著阿達叔叔進入繪本探險、拜訪台灣各領域的專家、破解歷史的祕密、跟著動物專家上山尋寶……，每一次的冒險都緊張刺激、精采得不得了！

programme.title: 百味小廚神-中元大餐第1集
programme.desc: 天生怕鬼的男孩翰旻，遺傳到阿公孤龍師的通靈眼，每年中元節，阿公都會拿出總鋪師的看家本領，辦桌款待好兄弟，沒想到阿公在今年中元節前夕意外離世，翰旻看到阿公的靈魂，發現阿公不再記得所有回憶，為了讓阿公恢復記憶，翰旻決定瞞著爸爸，決心挑戰重現這位老總舖師在食譜裡記下的每道料理，動手做菜給鬼吃，展開一場美味的冒險旅程。

programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第4集
programme.desc: 黎蘭章出生於南部農家，從小跟著父親做農，結婚後家庭幸福美滿，孰料先生早逝，她獨力撫養兩個孩子，這段期間蘭章受到朋友同事的關心與照顧，才能度過人生的低潮，為了回饋社會的愛心，蘭章加入了慈濟。因受到上人的感召，蘭章自認文的不會，武的也不會，只會做環保。蘭章十幾年不感動許多志工紛紛加入，但困難的是始終沒有固定的環保點，她的堅持與不退，感動了麗梅師姊，提供固定的場地給蘭章做環保，也終於不用再流浪。她們用做環保來實踐上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，蘭章跟麗梅認為環保道場就是人間淨土，也是她們及志工們的心靈修道場。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第199集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 名人書房第95集
programme.desc: 閱讀就像是漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中！每位名人的讀書故事，皆是一段動人的奇幻旅程，透過《名人書房》紀錄影片帶領大眾看見閱讀改變生命的力量。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第284集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 風月同天第44集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 衲履足跡第1467集
programme.desc: 以 證嚴上人出門行腳各地的隨緣開示為內容，近距離同霑一代宗師的法髓甘露與清淨智慧。以真實記錄譜寫現代阿含經，使全球大眾如同親隨。

programme.title: 映照人生第527集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 名人書房第96集
programme.desc: 閱讀就像是漫步在別人的思想與靈魂當中！每位名人的讀書故事，皆是一段動人的奇幻旅程，透過《名人書房》紀錄影片帶領大眾看見閱讀改變生命的力量。

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 人文講堂第548集
programme.desc: 《人文講堂》節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士、學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養、人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以講演方式，直接與大眾分享。講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點。

programme.title: 大愛全紀實第199集
programme.desc: 慈濟四大八法推廣與傳播,關注地球與人類永續發展議題。 解讀近代事件中，慈濟「曾經」參與的足跡，至今「正在」持續的行動，以及留給「未來」的影響力。 為觀眾傳播慈濟四大八法，剖析探討慈濟人如何關注地球永續發展、推動拔苦予樂的希望工程。

programme.title: 大愛影展第144集
programme.desc: 精選近幾年來在台灣大銀幕上映，擁有教化人心、帶給人心靈收穫的日本、韓國電影，希望透過每周一集的電影內容，傳遞美善的信念以及溫暖人心的力量。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第283集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待。好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭、刻骨銘心。 《證嚴上人說故事》是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶。在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被『名』枷『利』鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失。

programme.title: 證嚴上人說法華第28集
programme.desc: 彙整歷年法藏，重現智慧法語。《證嚴上人說法華》精選晨語開示，提綱挈領導讀《法華經》核心精神。此經譽為諸經之王，上人致力將深奧教義化為現代「菩薩道」，以實踐足跡印證經文，強調「不只誦經，更要行經」。透過濃縮法要，引領大眾深入淺出體悟教菩薩法，讓歷久彌新的法髓延續靈山感動，回歸清淨本性。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1045集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 行動現場第567集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 幸福的起點第10集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.desc: 關於「吃」，該怎麼吃得有智慧、吃出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解臺灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第722集
programme.desc: 京都富商的二女兒今井阿淺(波琉飾)在大阪創立礦碳公司、銀行、生命保險公司等一系列活動，並竭盡全力設立日本第一所女子大學的故事。阿淺的人物原型是被稱爲明治時代女中豪傑的實業家廣岡淺子。這是晨間劇故事首次從幕府末代拉開序幕，引發熱議。同時出演的還有宮崎葵、寺島忍、玉木宏等演員。

programme.title: 愛的人生路第24集
programme.desc: 余樹木和老婆元美生了五個女兒，年過四十仍無子嗣，為了傳承香火，元美安排丈夫娶了二房綉蘭。綉蘭不負所望生下天助，原以為家庭從此圓滿和樂，未料元美早逝，大女兒阿雪和二媽綉蘭個性差異，經常為生活瑣事爭執，家庭失和，令天助十分痛苦。 余家這本難念的經，要怎麼轉變為幸福經，共走愛的人生路？

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1175集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6919集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 人間菩提

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 幸福的起點第10集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第25集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第746集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第6季:第429集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活為藍本的故事，其中一事一物均充滿著1970年代的懷舊氣息。故事發生的舞台是日本靜岡縣清水市，那是一個不折不扣的美麗港都，是個交通便利、漁產豐富、又與富士山為鄰的好地方。故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第13集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 墨雨雲間第2集

programme.title: 霹靂邪章之道劫龍戰第14集
programme.desc: 邪章現，魔冊十變；道劫起，龍戰千里：末天閻劂造烽煙，寰定乾坤命太玄。七仙恩怨，糾纏不休，午晦明夷再現武林，意圖不軌，此時但見漫天虹光，旖旎炫目，伴隨一道雷霆劍氣轟然而下的，是身形嬌小、年華荳蔻，卻盛氣凌人，誓斬叛徒的凌虛小道仙。

programme.title: 新霹靂英雄榜第172集
programme.desc: 《新霹靂英雄榜》是一部動作冒險類型的電視劇或電影系列，為霹靂布袋戲的新一代作品。故事背景設定在一個神秘的武林世界，充滿了武術、魔法和神秘力量。故事圍繞著一群英雄人物展開，他們各自擁有獨特的技能和身世背景。他們將面臨來自黑暗勢力和邪惡組織的威脅，必須團結一致，通過戰鬥和冒險來守護正義和保護世界的平衡。《新霹靂英雄榜》融合了激烈的打鬥場面、刺激的動作場景和細膩的角色發展，帶給觀眾一場震撼的視覺盛宴。劇情扣人心弦，充滿著驚險、奇幻和神秘的元素，同時也融入了人物之間的情感和義務的探討。這部作品以霹靂布袋戲的獨特風格和特色為基礎，結合了現代特效和技術，將傳統和現代元素相結合，呈現出一個全新的霹靂世界。觀

programme.title: 霹靂俠影之轟霆劍海錄第66集
programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑后，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 咱的城 咱的市 咱台灣的味第26集
programme.desc: 台灣是個美麗的寶島，一年四季都有不同的景色以及不同的物產，從本島到離島各地皆擁有自己獨特的味道，而更為人所津津樂道的除了台灣的美食，台灣的人情味更是世界聞名。 這次【咱的城 咱的市 咱台灣的味】將帶觀眾環島一周，以及去到澎湖及金門，走入各地的市場，以不同的飲食文化、季節性產物、店家手路菜、創意料理等角度，帶領大家了解各地美食背後的文化底蘊，增廣對當地飲食文化的認識，也增加節目的豐富度及視野。

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第74集

programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。
